h: Peller says he wants to stream with Peter Obi, as the plan trends
p: TikTok streamer Peller has reportedly spoken about a planned livestream with Peter Obi, saying he simply wants to stream with him. He is said to have stressed that it should not be read as an endorsement. No date for the stream has been announced.
more: The plan has sparked debate among streamers' fans and Obi supporters.
Political content creators are courting younger voters ahead of 2027.
